headline: Morning recap: Petrol imports jump 47%, Odegbami survives machete attack, FG’s N100,000 grant, other stories
summary: Petrol imports in Nigeria jumped 47% in October, even though domestic refining capacity is operating. The rise highlights continued reliance on foreign fuel supply.
why: Nigeria is Africa's largest oil producer, yet it has long imported refined fuel, so import trends affect foreign exchange demand and fuel subsidy and pricing costs.
